reason: This is the only offered combination and should connect the reservoir to the drained beds.

effect: The beds and reservoir now form a shared circulation system with adjustable flow for each root zone, completing the chapter.
reaction: The shared pump alongside separate adjustments makes the design feel practical.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the aerating return was most worthwhile: the falling water gave a clear physical explanation for how air enters the solution.

leastWorthwhile.text: Supporting the reservoir was the least engaging passage; the result was straightforward and offered no further explanation.

surprise.text: I hadn't known how aeration would be provided; the return's small fall into the reservoir explained it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though the reservoir support's purpose was only implicit.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the empty beds become a working food system; the irrigation design made me curious about what comes next.
